# Vijendra Kumar

> Portfolio of Vijendra Kumar, a Senior Software Engineer based in Bangalore, India, specializing in backend systems, real-time applications, Salesforce integrations, and edge-native deployments. This site documents professional work at Apsona and personal projects shipped to production.

Currently at Apsona (Sep 2024–present). Previously at Pratishthan Software Ventures (Finacle payment systems) and Tata Consultancy Services. Core stack: TypeScript, Node.js, React, PostgreSQL, Redis, AWS Lambda, and Cloudflare Workers + Durable Objects.

## Core Pages

- [Home](https://vijevira.in): Portfolio landing page and project index.
- [Resume](https://vijevira.in/resume): Full professional resume — experience, skills, education, achievements.
- [All Projects](https://vijevira.in/projects/all-projects/): Complete index of every project with detailed write-ups.

## Personal Projects

- [Zyvora](https://vijevira.in/projects/personal/zyvora/): Jira-like SaaS project management platform with Kanban, sprints, timeline views, multi-tenant RBAC, Socket.IO real-time collaboration, and a BullMQ notification pipeline. TypeScript monorepo. Live at [zyvora.endra.in](https://zyvora.endra.in).
- [WatchTower](https://vijevira.in/projects/personal/watchtower/): SaaS platform monitoring HTML pages, RSS feeds, and JSON APIs for changes, delivering to Discord, Slack, and Telegram via a three-stage BullMQ pipeline. Live at [watchtower.wasmer.app](https://watchtower.wasmer.app).
- [BlindShare](https://vijevira.in/projects/personal/blindshare/): Zero-persistence P2P sharing suite over WebRTC — files, text, code, secrets, view-once media, and screen share. Live at [blindshare.in](https://blindshare.in).
- [BlindParty](https://vijevira.in/projects/personal/blindparty/): P2P watch party, video call, and ephemeral group chat for up to 6 peers over a full WebRTC mesh. Live at [party.blindshare.in](https://party.blindshare.in).
- [Chhakkadi](https://vijevira.in/projects/personal/chhakkadi-game/): Real-time multiplayer platform for three Indian trick-taking card games — Chhakkadi, Dehla Pakad, and Call Break — with bot AI. Live at [chhakkadi.endra.in](https://chhakkadi.endra.in).
- [Cuff the Bluff](https://vijevira.in/projects/personal/cuff-the-bluff/): Real-time Liar's Dice game for up to 15 players with probability-based bot AI on Cloudflare Durable Objects. Live at [cuffthebluff.endra.in](https://cuffthebluff.endra.in).
- [Splendor](https://vijevira.in/projects/personal/splendor/): Full digital implementation of the Splendor board game for 2–12 players with bot AI and procedural SVG card art. Live at [splendor.endra.in](https://splendor.endra.in).
- [Cabo](https://vijevira.in/projects/personal/cabo-card-game/): Real-time multiplayer Cabo card game for 2–15 players with bot AI and the Show mechanic. Live at [cabo.endra.in](https://cabo.endra.in).
- [Notes App](https://vijevira.in/projects/personal/notes-app/): Google Keep–inspired note manager with tagging, search, archive, and reminders.

## Professional Work

- [Apsona Triggered Merge](https://vijevira.in/projects/apsona/triggered-merge/): End-to-end Salesforce document automation — Flow to Platform Event to Apex Trigger to AWS API Gateway to Lambda, with license validation, replay mechanism, configurable Scheduled Apex cleanup, and an internal monitoring dashboard.
- [SEPA Payment System](https://vijevira.in/projects/pratishthan/sepa-payment/): Single Euro Payments Area outbound and inbound collections, Recall lead-day validation, Return and Reject handling with sanction checks.
- [QCBIP Payment System](https://vijevira.in/projects/pratishthan/qcbip-payment/): Qatar real-time payment system for sponsor and destination banks with sub-second SLA compliance.
- [UAERT Payment System](https://vijevira.in/projects/pratishthan/uaert-payment/): UAE real-time payment system with RCPI and NCPI flow enhancements.
- [NACH Payment System](https://vijevira.in/projects/pratishthan/nach-payment/): National Automated Clearing House outbound payments and inbound collections.
- [SWIFT Payment System](https://vijevira.in/projects/pratishthan/swift-payment/): Charge calculation and partTrans creation for accurate settlements.
